def review_state_lines(
    item: ReviewItem,
    row: Callable[[str, object], str],
) -> list[str]:
    """Return browser-authoritative and staged operator values with clear labels."""
    lines: list[str] = []
    if item.current_value:
        label = "Browser value" if item.staged_resolution else "Current"
        lines.append(row(label, item.current_value))
    if item.staged_value is not None:
        lines.append(row("Staged draft", item.staged_value))
    if item.staged_feedback_note:
        lines.append(row("Staged note", item.staged_feedback_note))
    return lines


    visible_resolution = item.resolution or item.staged_resolution
    res_color = RESOLUTION_COLORS.get(visible_resolution, COLOR_REVIEW)
    res_str = (
        item.resolution
        or (f"staged {item.staged_resolution}" if item.staged_resolution else "")
        or src.key_catalog.SV_PENDING
    )
    if item.staged_value is not None:
        return f"Draft: {item.staged_value}"
    decision = (
        item.resolution
        or (f"staged {item.staged_resolution}" if item.staged_resolution else "")
        or src.key_catalog.SV_PENDING
    )
    decision_color = RESOLUTION_COLORS.get(
        item.resolution or item.staged_resolution,
        COLOR_MUTED,
    )
